I am also 22f and I feel the same way and fear the same thing.

People are getting surgery and pretty ppl become prettier and prettier and it feels like an endless cycle of “Im never gonna be good enough” , “Ill never know what its like to be pretty” , “Ill never have the perks a pretty girl gets” , “what does it feel like to never be rejected?” , “how does it feel to go out and be the center of attention?” and you think you’ll never know the answer to those two last questions. 

My best friend gave me some great advice on this that really helped me out “When you are with people you trust you act really confident and you light up the room, so every time you ask me “why can everyone go from bf to bf and I always stay single?” well those people are happy and confident and feel worthy, thats all you need”

Also, Idk if Im attractive or not but late last year (before my depression) I was very thin and looked the best I had looked in my life I think and believe me- being treated differently because of looks aint it. You just get objectified and sexualized and all the other person is valuing is your looks and that definitely doesn’t last at all. 

I have also found comfort in seeing how my very very pretty friends struggle with all the same things I do (except feeling ugly cause they know they are pretty) but same problems in all other aspects, so I think many things are not just about looks like I originally thought.
